verdict.rationale: Pika documents generating clips or full videos from user-supplied references (pika-docs-9), and its Short Film app lets you set a style and add references for multi-shot films (pika-docs-45). Motion Transfer and Pikaframes also drive output from reference videos or stills (pika-docs-15, pika-docs-46, pika-docs-51), but these carry over motion or keyframes rather than visual style, and restyling is documented only for images (pika-docs-5). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that a reference video or image's visual style is transferred to newly generated footage, a dedicated style-reference or video-to-video restyle feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration of style fidelity.
